provenance: Synthetic examples created for the POC. These are not real Progressive incidents, verified historical tickets, or production resolutions. Use them only as starting-point patterns; validate all checks against current evidence and approved runbooks.
status_semantics: illustrative_resolved means the sample scenario includes a representative resolution workflow; it does not assert a real incident occurred.

cases.issue_summary: Transaction premium differs from the source record
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow reconciled the same transaction and revision across source, transaction, and coverage values, then localized the first amount difference.

resolution_steps.title: Trace the transaction
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare the policy and revision in `gold_fact_policy_transaction` with the corresponding source values in `silver_wc_policy_transaction`.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm the same transaction and revision are being compared.

resolution_steps.title: Reconcile coverage amounts
resolution_steps.instruction: Sum `written_premium` in `gold_fact_coverage` for the transaction and compare it with the transaction premium.
resolution_steps.verify: Record any difference before checking downstream totals.

resolution_steps.title: Check the transformation path
resolution_steps.instruction: If the values first diverge upstream, review the matching Bronze and Silver records and the approved transformation logic.
resolution_steps.verify: Identify the earliest layer where the amount changes.

cases.watch_for: Check whether the comparison uses the same transaction revision; a policy-level total can hide a transaction mismatch.

cases.issue_summary: Policy premium total changes between transaction revisions
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow aligned the included policy revisions and transaction types, then reconciled coverage subtotals to each transaction.

resolution_steps.title: Compare revisions
resolution_steps.instruction: Review `policy_revision_number`, `transaction_type`, and `written_premium_total` in `gold_fact_policy_transaction`.
resolution_steps.verify: Ensure the requested total includes the intended revisions and transaction types.

resolution_steps.title: Rebuild from coverage
resolution_steps.instruction: Aggregate `gold_fact_coverage.written_premium` by transaction before comparing it with the transaction fact.
resolution_steps.verify: The coverage subtotal should reconcile to the same transaction.

resolution_steps.title: Trace the first difference
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare the matching Silver transaction with its Gold transaction record.
resolution_steps.verify: Note the first layer and revision where totals differ.

cases.watch_for: A revision filter mismatch can make correct records appear missing or overstated.

cases.issue_summary: Premium changes after aggregation
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow found a one-to-many join inflating premium rows and restored reconciliation by aggregating each fact set first.

resolution_steps.title: Check the base grain
resolution_steps.instruction: Count rows by `source_transaction_id` in `gold_fact_policy_transaction` and `gold_fact_coverage`.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm each side is aggregated at its own transaction grain.

resolution_steps.title: Review joins
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare transaction and coverage totals separately before combining them; do not join raw coverage and charge rows together.
resolution_steps.verify: Look for repeated transaction amounts after a one-to-many join.

resolution_steps.title: Reconcile in order
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare Silver transaction values to Gold transactions, then compare Gold coverage subtotals.
resolution_steps.verify: Find the earliest stage where the aggregated total changes.

cases.watch_for: Joining two one-to-many fact sets before aggregation can multiply premium rows.

cases.issue_summary: Coverage is present upstream but absent in Gold
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow found the expected coverage in Silver, then traced the missing Gold row to a code or key mapping filter.

resolution_steps.title: Check Silver coverage
resolution_steps.instruction: Find the policy transaction in `silver_wc_coverage` and note its `coverage_code` and `source_transaction_id`.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm the expected coverage row exists before the Gold load.

resolution_steps.title: Check Gold coverage
resolution_steps.instruction: Look for the same transaction and coverage code in `gold_fact_coverage`.
resolution_steps.verify: A Silver row without a matching Gold row localizes the gap to the Gold transform/load.

resolution_steps.title: Review mapping and filters
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare the applicable Gold transformation filters and key mapping against the source row.
resolution_steps.verify: Capture the first filter or key that excludes the coverage.

cases.watch_for: A missing Gold coverage row is most directly checked by transaction ID and coverage code.

cases.issue_summary: Coverage code is not represented in the reporting output
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow matched the source coverage code to its approved mapping and verified the resulting Gold coverage attributes.

resolution_steps.title: Verify the source code
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare `coverage_code` in `silver_wc_coverage` with the corresponding value in `gold_fact_coverage`.
resolution_steps.verify: Check for null, whitespace, or code-format differences.

resolution_steps.title: Review the code mapping
resolution_steps.instruction: Check the approved coverage mapping used by the transformation for the affected code.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm the code maps to an expected coverage record.

resolution_steps.title: Validate the output
resolution_steps.instruction: Check `coverage_name` and `written_premium` for the matching Gold row.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm the coverage appears once with the expected mapped attributes.

cases.watch_for: A code-format or unmapped-code issue can look like a missing coverage.

cases.issue_summary: Coverage row is lost during a policy join
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow corrected the transaction-to-policy join key so the existing coverage row remained in the reporting output.

resolution_steps.title: Trace the transaction key
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare `source_transaction_id` and `gold_policy_sk` between `gold_fact_coverage` and `gold_dim_policy_jacket`.
resolution_steps.verify: Check that the fact row has a matching dimension key.

resolution_steps.title: Inspect join behavior
resolution_steps.instruction: Review whether the transformation uses the expected key and preserves coverage rows when policy attributes are absent.
resolution_steps.verify: Identify rows removed by the join condition.

resolution_steps.title: Verify coverage output
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare coverage counts by transaction in Silver and Gold.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm the missing row is accounted for by a documented filter or mapping.

cases.watch_for: A join-key mismatch can drop coverage even when the source row exists.

cases.issue_summary: Policy status does not match its latest transaction
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow applied the documented latest-revision ordering and aligned the policy dimension status to that transaction.

resolution_steps.title: Order the transactions
resolution_steps.instruction: Review `transaction_date`, `policy_revision_number`, and `transaction_type` in `gold_fact_policy_transaction`.
resolution_steps.verify: Determine which record is latest under the documented business rule.

resolution_steps.title: Compare status fields
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare the selected transaction status with `policy_status` in `gold_dim_policy_jacket`.
resolution_steps.verify: Record whether the dimension reflects the correct latest transaction.

resolution_steps.title: Check derivation logic
resolution_steps.instruction: Trace the policy status from `silver_wc_policy_transaction` into the Gold dimension.
resolution_steps.verify: Locate any ordering, filter, or mapping difference.

cases.watch_for: Ties in transaction date may require the documented revision ordering rule.

cases.issue_summary: A source status maps to an unexpected reporting status
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow identified a source status value not covered by the mapping and confirmed the approved normalized value.

resolution_steps.title: Compare source and Gold
resolution_steps.instruction: Review the policy status in `silver_wc_policy` and the resulting status in `gold_dim_policy_jacket`.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm the source status value and reporting value.

resolution_steps.title: Inspect status mapping
resolution_steps.instruction: Check the approved status mapping and any normalization applied in the Gold transformation.
resolution_steps.verify: Look for an unhandled source value or inconsistent spelling.

resolution_steps.title: Check transaction history
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare the latest `gold_fact_policy_transaction` status and date with the dimension value.
resolution_steps.verify: Verify the final status follows the documented precedence rule.

cases.watch_for: A newly encountered source status may not be covered by the current mapping.

cases.issue_summary: The same source transaction appears more than once
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow distinguished legitimate revisions from repeated source transaction IDs and isolated the duplicate load.

resolution_steps.title: Find repeated identifiers
resolution_steps.instruction: Group `gold_fact_policy_transaction` by `source_transaction_id` and inspect counts above one.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm whether rows are true duplicates or distinct revisions.

resolution_steps.title: Compare business attributes
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare policy number, revision, transaction type, and transaction date for the repeated rows.
resolution_steps.verify: Separate legitimate revisions from duplicate loads.

resolution_steps.title: Trace upstream
resolution_steps.instruction: Check the matching `silver_wc_policy_transaction` rows and the Gold load's deduplication key.
resolution_steps.verify: Identify where an identical transaction was repeated.

cases.watch_for: Repeated IDs can be valid only when the documented grain and revision keys explain them.

cases.issue_summary: A policy revision is duplicated in reporting
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow confirmed the duplicate existed upstream and applied the documented transaction-level deduplication rule.

resolution_steps.title: Check the transaction grain
resolution_steps.instruction: Inspect rows by policy number, `policy_revision_number`, and `source_transaction_id` in `gold_fact_policy_transaction`.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm whether duplicate rows share all transaction identifiers.

resolution_steps.title: Compare Silver input
resolution_steps.instruction: Check whether the same duplicate already exists in `silver_wc_policy_transaction`.
resolution_steps.verify: This distinguishes upstream duplication from Gold processing.

resolution_steps.title: Review deduplication
resolution_steps.instruction: Inspect the Gold transformation's documented deduplication key and ordering.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm the retained row follows the approved rule.

cases.watch_for: Do not treat different revisions for one policy as duplicates without checking the transaction key.

cases.issue_summary: Expected policy records are absent from the batch
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow located the batch gap by checking raw-file arrival, Bronze parsing, and downstream layer counts in sequence.

resolution_steps.title: Confirm file arrival
resolution_steps.instruction: Check the expected file or batch identifier in `bronze_wc_xml_raw`.
resolution_steps.verify: Verify the batch was received and recorded.

resolution_steps.title: Check parsed records
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare the batch's policy records in `bronze_wc_policy` with the raw-file record.
resolution_steps.verify: Determine whether the gap occurred before or during parsing.

resolution_steps.title: Trace the batch forward
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare policy and transaction counts across Bronze, Silver, and Gold for the same batch context.
resolution_steps.verify: Identify the first layer where expected records are absent.

cases.watch_for: An absent raw-file record points to arrival; a present raw file with no parsed row points to ingestion/parsing.

cases.issue_summary: A policy transaction is absent from Gold
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow identified the first failed pipeline activity and confirmed the last completed data layer before owner review.

resolution_steps.title: Check Silver input
resolution_steps.instruction: Search `silver_wc_policy_transaction` for the policy and source transaction.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm whether the expected transaction reached Silver.

resolution_steps.title: Check Gold fact
resolution_steps.instruction: Search `gold_fact_policy_transaction` with the same transaction identifier and revision.
resolution_steps.verify: Determine whether the row was omitted in the Gold load.

resolution_steps.title: Review dimension linkage
resolution_steps.instruction: If the fact exists, verify its `gold_policy_sk` matches `gold_dim_policy_jacket`.
resolution_steps.verify: Separate a missing fact from a missing policy-dimension match.

cases.watch_for: Use the source transaction identifier to avoid confusing a missing row with another revision.

cases.issue_summary: The policy batch did not complete
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow traced the missing target field to its approved source-to-target mapping and validated the mapped sample record.

resolution_steps.title: Inspect the failed run
resolution_steps.instruction: Review the approved ADF run details and identify the first failed activity for the affected batch.
resolution_steps.verify: Capture activity name, run time, and error summary.

resolution_steps.title: Check the last completed layer
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare batch records in `bronze_wc_xml_raw`, `silver_wc_policy_transaction`, and `gold_fact_policy_transaction`.
resolution_steps.verify: Find the latest layer with completed records.

resolution_steps.title: Verify retry safety
resolution_steps.instruction: Check the runbook and activity outcome before requesting a retry from the pipeline owner.
resolution_steps.verify: Do not rerun until the owner confirms retry is safe.

cases.watch_for: A failed downstream activity may leave earlier layers populated; check the batch boundary first.

cases.issue_summary: A required policy field is missing in a downstream mapping
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow found the first layer where premium became null and verified its effect on transaction reconciliation.

resolution_steps.title: Compare mapped fields
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare the affected Gold field with the corresponding documented Silver field in the WC knowledge base.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm the source field has a value before the downstream mapping.

resolution_steps.title: Review mapping specification
resolution_steps.instruction: Check the approved Informatica mapping and its source-to-target rule with the platform owner.
resolution_steps.verify: Look for an omitted field, rename, or conditional expression.

resolution_steps.title: Validate a sample
resolution_steps.instruction: Trace one affected policy through the documented source and target records.
resolution_steps.verify: Record the first point where the field becomes null or changes.

cases.watch_for: The POC knowledge base does not define EDW table names; use the approved mapping specification rather than guessing them.

cases.issue_summary: A premium field is null in the reporting layer
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow isolated repeated charges and reconciled charge totals separately to avoid multiplying them with coverage rows.

resolution_steps.title: Check the source value
resolution_steps.instruction: Inspect the matching `written_premium` in `silver_wc_coverage` for the affected transaction.
resolution_steps.verify: Determine whether the null exists before Gold processing.

resolution_steps.title: Compare Gold output
resolution_steps.instruction: Check `written_premium` in `gold_fact_coverage` for the same transaction and coverage code.
resolution_steps.verify: If Silver is populated but Gold is null, review the transform expression.

resolution_steps.title: Review aggregation handling
resolution_steps.instruction: Check how null coverage amounts are treated when reconciling to `gold_fact_policy_transaction`.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm the null is not silently changing the total.

cases.watch_for: A null at the Silver layer suggests source parsing or normalization; a Gold-only null suggests transform handling.

cases.issue_summary: Fees or surcharges appear duplicated
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow traced the missing charge from Silver to Gold and identified the first differing charge attribute or filter.

resolution_steps.title: Check charge grain
resolution_steps.instruction: Inspect `gold_fact_charge` by `source_charge_id`, transaction ID, and policy revision.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm repeated charge IDs are not separate valid charge rows.

resolution_steps.title: Compare upstream charges
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare the identified rows with `silver_wc_charge` for the same transaction.
resolution_steps.verify: Determine whether duplication entered before or during Gold loading.

resolution_steps.title: Reconcile separately
resolution_steps.instruction: Aggregate charges by transaction before combining them with coverage or transaction facts.
resolution_steps.verify: Avoid a raw charge-to-coverage join that multiplies amounts.

cases.watch_for: Charge and coverage are both one-to-many; joining both raw sets can inflate totals.

cases.issue_summary: A source fee or surcharge is absent in the reporting layer
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow aligned the policy term to the correct revision and located the date conversion or selection difference.

resolution_steps.title: Check Silver charges
resolution_steps.instruction: Find the charge in `silver_wc_charge` by transaction and source charge identifier.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm it reached the standardized layer.

resolution_steps.title: Check Gold charges
resolution_steps.instruction: Search `gold_fact_charge` for the same transaction and charge type.
resolution_steps.verify: Identify whether the charge was lost in Gold mapping or filtering.

resolution_steps.title: Compare charge attributes
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare `amount`, `charge_type`, and `coverage_code` across the matching rows.
resolution_steps.verify: Note the first field or row that differs.

cases.watch_for: A missing charge may be filtered by charge type or by a missing transaction key.

cases.issue_summary: Policy term dates do not align with transaction history
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow found an unmapped class or coverage code and confirmed the expected mapped attribute with the owner.

resolution_steps.title: Compare policy dates
resolution_steps.instruction: Review effective and expiration dates in `gold_dim_policy_jacket` for the policy revision.
resolution_steps.verify: Record the dates displayed in the reporting dimension.

resolution_steps.title: Check transaction dates
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare transaction and effective dates in `gold_fact_policy_transaction`.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm the correct revision supplies the current term.

resolution_steps.title: Trace upstream mapping
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare the same policy dates in `silver_wc_policy` and review the documented date conversion.
resolution_steps.verify: Identify a parsing, timezone, or revision-selection difference.

cases.watch_for: A later transaction date does not necessarily mean a later effective date.

cases.issue_summary: A class code or coverage attribute is missing
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow reconciled coverage totals at transaction grain and identified the rows driving the variance.

resolution_steps.title: Check Silver attributes
resolution_steps.instruction: Inspect `class_code` and `coverage_code` in `silver_wc_coverage` for the affected policy transaction.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm the input values are populated.

resolution_steps.title: Compare Gold attributes
resolution_steps.instruction: Check the corresponding columns in `gold_fact_coverage`.
resolution_steps.verify: Identify whether the value was dropped or changed in Gold.

resolution_steps.title: Review approved mapping
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare the source code with the documented mapping rule used by the transformation.
resolution_steps.verify: Capture any unmapped value for review by the data owner.

cases.watch_for: An unmapped source code can preserve the coverage row while leaving a descriptive attribute blank.

cases.issue_summary: Coverage premium subtotals do not reconcile
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow confirmed the raw XML arrived, then isolated the missing parsed policy to an ingestion or structure issue.

resolution_steps.title: Aggregate coverage rows
resolution_steps.instruction: Sum `written_premium` in `gold_fact_coverage` by source transaction.
resolution_steps.verify: Use the same transaction and revision scope as the comparison.

resolution_steps.title: Compare transaction fact
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare that subtotal with `written_premium_total` in `gold_fact_policy_transaction`.
resolution_steps.verify: Quantify the variance by transaction before policy-level rollup.

resolution_steps.title: Trace differing rows
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare coverage rows and premium values in `silver_wc_coverage` with Gold.
resolution_steps.verify: Find missing, duplicated, or changed coverage amounts.

cases.watch_for: Reconcile at transaction grain first; policy totals may net differences across revisions.

cases.issue_summary: A raw XML policy record is not represented in Bronze parsed rows
cases.resolution_summary: The sample workflow restored the version-specific policy dimension lookup and verified the fact's surrogate-key link.

resolution_steps.title: Locate the raw file
resolution_steps.instruction: Find the expected file in `bronze_wc_xml_raw` and verify the batch/file identifier.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm the raw payload was ingested.

resolution_steps.title: Check parsed policy rows
resolution_steps.instruction: Search `bronze_wc_policy` for the affected policy and transaction.
resolution_steps.verify: If absent, the issue is before or during policy parsing.

resolution_steps.title: Review parse evidence
resolution_steps.instruction: Inspect available ingestion status or error details and compare the XML structure with the documented fields.
resolution_steps.verify: Record the parse error or unexpected field path for the pipeline owner.

cases.watch_for: A raw file present with no parsed policy row suggests a parsing or schema-shape issue.

cases.issue_summary: A transaction fails to link to its policy dimension
cases.resolution_summary: Illustrative workflow: trace the affected value across the documented layers, compare at the correct record grain, and verify the earliest divergence.

resolution_steps.title: Check the dimension row
resolution_steps.instruction: Find the policy number and revision in `gold_dim_policy_jacket` and note `gold_policy_sk`.
resolution_steps.verify: Confirm the expected dimension version exists.

resolution_steps.title: Check the fact key
resolution_steps.instruction: Compare `gold_policy_sk` and policy/revision values in `gold_fact_policy_transaction`.
resolution_steps.verify: Verify the fact references the intended dimension version.

resolution_steps.title: Trace the key mapping
resolution_steps.instruction: Review the Silver-to-Gold key resolution for the same policy and revision.
resolution_steps.verify: Identify a missing dimension lookup or mismatched key.

cases.watch_for: The policy number can exist in both tables while a version-specific surrogate-key link is missing.
